name: Proctor public scam sample
note: Public items written for Proctor. Never part of any private test set. All names, numbers, brands and domains are fictional (UK +44 7700 900xxx test range, example.* domains).

items.text: Hi Mum it's me, dropped my phone in the sink so this is my new number for now, can you save it? Bit awkward but I need to pay my rent today and my banking app won't let me log in on the new phone. Could you send £640 to my landlord's account? Sort code 04-00-75, acc 21873364, name D. Okafor. I'll pay you back Friday x
items.label: SCAM
items.rationale: Unknown number claiming to be family, urgency, money to a third party's account.

items.text: Grandma? It's Josh. Please don't be mad. I was in a car accident and the police say I have to pay bail before they let me go. My lawyer Mr Hale is going to call you in a minute. Please don't tell Mum and Dad, I'll explain everything later. He said cash or gift cards is the fastest way.
items.label: SCAM
items.rationale: Grandparent scam: secrecy, urgency, bail, gift cards.

items.text: Northfield Bank: A payment of £1,249.00 to EVR-TRADE LTD is pending. If this was NOT you, call our fraud team immediately on 0808 157 0192 to cancel it.
items.label: SCAM
items.rationale: Fake fraud alert pushing the reader to call a number given in the message.

items.text: Hello, this is Daniel from the security team at Northfield Bank. We've blocked a suspicious transfer on your account. To confirm you're the account holder I've just sent you a six-digit code. Can you read it back to me so I can cancel the transfer?
items.label: SCAM
items.rationale: Asks the reader to read out a one-time code.

items.text: ParcelSwift: Your parcel could not be delivered due to an unpaid customs fee of £1.99. Pay within 24h or it will be returned to sender: https://parcelswift-redelivery.example.com/pay
items.label: SCAM
items.rationale: Small fee, deadline, payment link on a look-alike domain.

items.text: Hi Sarah, please find attached invoice BLP-2291 for the October flyers (£3,420.00). Just a heads-up that we've moved banks after our audit, so please use the new details below for this and all future payments: sort code 30-96-26, account 48810073. Our old account will be closed at the end of the month. Thanks, Mark
items.label: SCAM
items.rationale: Payee-change request on a look-alike domain.

items.text: Hey, sorry I think I messaged the wrong person 😅 I was trying to reach my cousin about the golf trip. You seem nice though! What do you do? I mostly work in tea export but honestly most of my income these days comes from a crypto arbitrage platform my uncle introduced me to, very steady.
items.label: SCAM
items.rationale: Wrong-number opener steered towards a crypto investment platform.

items.text: Hello! I'm Priya from TalentReach Recruitment. We have a flexible remote role: rate products online 30-60 min a day, £250-£400 per day, no experience needed. To activate your work account you just need to complete a starter task (minimum deposit 50 USDT, refunded with your first payout). Interested?
items.label: SCAM
items.rationale: Unrealistic pay and a deposit required to start work.

items.text: We detected 3 viruses on your device. Your files and banking data are at risk. Call certified support now on 0800 046 2213 or install our remote assistant tool to fix this immediately.
items.label: SCAM
items.rationale: Unsolicited virus warning pushing a call or remote-access install.

items.text: TAX OFFICE: You are owed a tax refund of £326.18 for the 2025/26 tax year. Claim before 31 Oct to avoid it expiring: https://tax-refund-claims.example.com
items.label: SCAM
items.rationale: Refund offered by text with a deadline and a non-official link.

items.text: Hi, I'll take the bike for your asking price of £180. I've just sent £430 by mistake through the marketplace's secure payment, the extra was meant for my courier who'll collect it. Could you transfer the £250 difference to the courier so he can come today? Screenshot of the payment attached.
items.label: SCAM
items.rationale: Overpayment and a request to send back the difference.

items.text: Hi Dad, it's Tomi, new number, my old phone finally died. Save this one! Are we still on for Sunday lunch? I'll bring dessert.
items.label: LEGIT
items.rationale: New-number message that asks for nothing.

items.text: Northfield Bank: Did you just try to pay £86.40 to SHOPLINE ONLINE? Reply YES or NO. We will never ask you for a code or to move money. If unsure, call the number on the back of your card.
items.label: LEGIT
items.rationale: Genuine fraud check: no link, no code request, points to the number on the card.

items.text: ParcelSwift: Your parcel from Greenway Books is out for delivery today between 13:00 and 15:00. Track it in the ParcelSwift app. No payment is needed.
items.label: LEGIT
items.rationale: Delivery update with no link and no payment.

items.text: Hi Sarah, invoice BLP-2302 for the November posters is attached (£1,180.00), payable within 30 days to our usual account ending 7731. Let me know if the quantities look off. Cheers, Mark
items.label: LEGIT
items.rationale: Normal invoice from the known supplier, unchanged payment details.

items.text: Hi Amara, I'm a recruiter at Halden Systems. Your profile matches a backend engineer role (hybrid, Manchester, £62-70k). Would you be open to a 20-minute call this week? The job description is here: https://careers.haldensystems.example.com/jobs/2214. There's no cost at any stage of our process.
items.label: LEGIT
items.rationale: Ordinary recruiter outreach, no payment asked.

items.text: Reminder: laptops will install the October security update tonight from 22:00. Please save your work and leave your laptop on charge. You don't need to do anything else. Questions? Raise a ticket on the IT portal.
items.label: LEGIT
items.rationale: Internal IT notice, no action beyond saving work.

items.text: New sign-in to your Coinvault account from Chrome on Windows in Lisbon, Portugal at 09:14 UTC. If this was you, you can ignore this email. If it wasn't, open the Coinvault app and go to Settings > Security to lock your account. We will never ask for your password, 2FA codes or recovery phrase.
items.label: LEGIT
items.rationale: Alarming but genuine security notice: no link, points to the app.

items.text: That dinner was great 😄 the bill came to £96 so £32 each. Here's my payment link when you get a chance, no rush: https://pay.example.com/chidi-o
items.label: LEGIT
items.rationale: Payment request from a saved contact for a shared bill, no pressure.

items.text: Your Self Assessment return for the 2025/26 tax year is due by 31 January. Sign in to your online tax account to file it. We will never send you a link to claim a refund by text or email.
items.label: LEGIT
items.rationale: Deadline reminder with no link and no request for details.
